title: Going deeper: Information before consequence
categoryContext: Growing independence at home, school and online
stageSummary: Use curiosity to find the barrier, perspective or missing information before deciding the response.
possibleWeather: Older children may hear pressure as mistrust, public judgement or loss of agency. Make the reason, choice and responsibility visible.
practice: ask one neutral question that can produce useful information
principle: Create a safer path to truthful information and proportionate repair.
nextSentence: Honesty and repair still matter. Tell me what is getting in the way, then we can ask one neutral question that can produce useful information.
keyLearning: Create a safer path to truthful information and proportionate repair.
